mapper.sql: tp.temporary_permission_id as "temporaryPermissionId", tp.user_id as "userId", case when kps.name is not null then kps.name else u.login_id end as "userName", tp.work_data_ref as "workDataRef", tp.function_type as "functionType", tp.valid_start_at as "validStartAt", tp.valid_end_at as "validEndAt", tp.status as "status", tp.change_reason as "changeReason", tp.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from temporary_permissions tp join users u on u.user_id = tp.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no
order by tp.updated_at desc, tp.temporary_permission_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select count(*) from users where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and system_use_yn = 'Y'

select from temporary_permissions tp join users u on u.user_id = tp.user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no where tp.temporary_permission_id = #{temporaryPermissionId}
mapper.insert: insert into temporary_permissions (user_id, work_data_ref, function_type, valid_start_at, valid_end_at, status, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{userId}, #{workDataRef}, #{functionType}, #{validStartAt}, #{validEndAt}, 'ACTIVE', #{changeReason}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update temporary_permissions set status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where status = 'ACTIVE' and valid_end_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
